dedupe_keys.name: icnf geocatalogo open geographic data of portugal protected areas forests burnt areas

description: The geoCATALOGO of ICNF, the Portuguese Institute for Nature Conservation and Forests, is a catalogue of open geographic data that can be searched, viewed and downloaded as ESRI shapefiles and KML or used through WMS and WFS services, with metadata, filtered by ICNF theme or INSPIRE theme. Its layers include the national network of protected areas and their special programmes, Natura 2000 special protection areas and special areas of conservation, Ramsar sites and biosphere reserves with their zoning; the national forest inventory (IFN) photo points under the forests theme; and, under the risks and threats theme, burnt areas from 1975 to 2025 as a combined layer and as yearly layers. The terms state that, unless otherwise indicated, the information is the property of ICNF and is provided free of charge as open data that can be used freely, provided that the source is cited with the layer name, download URL and date. Caveats: ICNF warns that data may contain technical inaccuracies or positional errors, is for general guidance, not legal purposes, and may be changed or withdrawn without notice. Coverage is Portugal. It supports wildfire hazard exposure and historical event analysis for power lines, roads and rail crossing forests, and environmental screening of infrastructure near protected areas; related records are EFFIS and the Greece FSim wildfire simulation dataset.
